title: M-PNatSS Onco Kids—Multicenter pilot study to investigate the feasibility and adherence of supervised sports therapy interventions in children and adolescents with cancer
summary:
Sports therapy in children and adolescents with cancer has been shown to improve health-related quality of life and reduce therapy-associated side effects. Sports therapy can support the patients during the anti cancer therapy.
The aim of this pilot study is to investigate the feasibility and adherence of regular sports therapy care for pediatric oncology patients during medical therapy.
Furthermore the performance prior and after the intervention of sports therapy will be checked.
In addition, the effects on patients' health-related quality of life will be documented.
conditions: Benefit for children and adolescents with cancer after sports therapy

interventions.name:

•    Prospective, multicenter, non-randomized pre-post pilot study

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
malignant disease
in therapy
Exclusion criteria:
no understanding

Exclusion criteria: Temporary contraindications (leading to the postponement or suspension of individual training sessions or tests):
o    Unstable vital signs
o    Acute infections or febrile neutropenia
o    Thrombocytopenia < 10,000/µl or < 20,000/µl with signs of bleeding
